source: Original PC executable, reflected compiled shader assembly, and bounded original callback emulation
templateRelationship: Separate precompiled FaceOn shader programs; not a branch in the generic embedded Nu2 HLSL template.

transformPacket.translation: matrix row 3 xyz moved into faceOnTranslation.xyz; matrix translation cleared; m33 is opacity then replaced with 1
transformPacket.transpose: Original callback transposes both matrices before upload.
transformPacket.tint: global vec4 at 0x986ea0; alpha multiplied by saved m33 only when m33 < 1
transformPacket.depth: When opacity < 1 sets render states (7,1), (14,0), (23,4); otherwise restores material depth mode.

shaderMath.convention: Equations use D3D constant-register row vectors directly, as named cN in assembly; avoids row/column serialization ambiguity.
shaderMath.pixelHigh: Same color/fog/alpha; writes extra render target [0.5,0.5,0.5,1].

limits: Transform/constant and shader mathematics are recovered; original GPU pixels have not been compared.
Live construction of the view-facing transform packet and complete draw ordering still require runtime reconstruction.
glTF preview remains a fixed XY expansion; original center and corner data retained.
The generic 49,109-material feature survey does not substitute for this dedicated face-on material path.
